logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting job illustration for the WO-01 pump-module decision report. Show a water-reclamation transfer loop receiving a selected pump module. On one side, a four-bar chart of measured acceptance-run energy (P1 56, P2 12, P3 52, P4 58 kWh) with P2 highlighted as the lowest-energy qualifying module; on the other side, a schematic loop with tank, pump module and transfer line, and a check-mark badge on the selected module. Include small labels: quality index and defect count for each candidate (P1 84/4, P2 97/1, P3 80/3, P4 81/0), the policy gates (quality ≥ 80, defects ≤ 5), and the energy gap P2 over P3 of 40 kWh. Clean industrial-technical style, readable serif labels, muted blue-gray palette with one accent color for P2.
